UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Authenticated user's saved game favorites and custom left-side column names (contains no PII).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

favoriteIds.description: Bounded list of up to 200 favorited game IDs matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$ (max 120 chars each).

customColumns.description: Bounded list of up to 30 custom column titles matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9 _\-]+$ (max 32 chars each).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the workspace document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest workspace update.

SuggestionNote.title: SuggestionNote
SuggestionNote.description: Player suggestion note submitted from JordS1.1 Settings to Jordan's AI Studio inbox.

senderName.description: Short nickname of the player submitting the suggestion (no email/PII).

serverSource.description: Server label from which the suggestion was submitted.

targetId.description: Routing identifier targeting Jordan's AI Studio inbox.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the suggestion was created.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: System-only administrator marker keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin record was provisioned.

/userWorkspaces/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/suggestions/{suggestionId}.description: Suggestions submitted from JordS1.1 Settings and viewable by admin in AI Studio.
